name: SCCPMS
description: Smart Campus Clinic Patient & Management  System

paragraphs: SCCPMS is a university clinic application with a React/TypeScript frontend, an Express API, Supabase Auth, and PostgreSQL records. The active frontend is the repository root src/; the active backend is server/.
For GitHub-to-Vercel deployment, use the deployment guide. Import the same repository into two projects:

The live frontend is sccpms.vercel.app; the live API is sccpms-api.vercel.app, with a passing database health check. Both deploy automatically from this repository's main branch and have separate environment variables and vercel.json. Testing results and failure history distinguish local, cloud, browser and real database checks. Brevo API and Supabase SMTP delivery checks are reported delivered, and live email redirects were inspected. The bound owner administrator retains its Resend OTP route. Real signup/invitation completion and clinical operating acceptance still require authorized users.
